cases.name: block-description-with-metadata
cases.description: A literal-block description (with a blank line and quotes) becomes one TOML string; the metadata block, with the reconciled version added, is preserved as comments.

input.markdown:
---
name: fixture-agent
description: |
  Reviews code.

  Use when a "why" is needed.
model: gpt-5
metadata:
  author: Fixture Author
---
Review carefully.
Report "why".

expected.reconciled_markdown:
---
name: fixture-agent
description: |
  Reviews code.

  Use when a "why" is needed.
model: gpt-5
metadata:
  version: "2.4.6"
  author: Fixture Author
---
Review carefully.
Report "why".
expected.codex_toml:
# Generated by cmx from a portable Markdown agent. Frontmatter Codex has no
# key for is kept below as YAML so cmx can read it back; Codex ignores comments.
# ---
# metadata:
#   version: "2.4.6"
#   author: Fixture Author
# ---
name = "fixture-agent"
description = "Reviews code.\n\nUse when a \"why\" is needed."
model = "gpt-5"
developer_instructions = "Review carefully.\nReport \"why\"."

cases.name: plain-description-version-only
cases.description: A plain single-line description; the only preserved frontmatter is the metadata block reconciliation appends.

input.markdown:
---
name: fixture-agent
description: Reviews code
---
Review carefully.

expected.reconciled_markdown:
---
name: fixture-agent
description: Reviews code
metadata:
  version: "2.4.6"
---
Review carefully.
expected.codex_toml:
# Generated by cmx from a portable Markdown agent. Frontmatter Codex has no
# key for is kept below as YAML so cmx can read it back; Codex ignores comments.
# ---
# metadata:
#   version: "2.4.6"
# ---
name = "fixture-agent"
description = "Reviews code"
developer_instructions = "Review carefully."
